brief: The canvas presents an abstract, deep aerial panorama of a densely packed metropolitan cityscape rendered entirely in monochromatic tones. Flowing streaks of light trace the geometry of the urban sprawl, converging at major intersections. Instead of simple points, these crossings form defined, angular crystalline clusters. The most striking element is the internal quality of these formations: they appear to glow from within, displaying a visible radial gradient that gives the entire sprawling, detailed scene a sense of profound depth and luminous energy.

statement: This sketch creates a monochromatic urban landscape where thousands of lights form a glowing cityscape. Using a spatial grid optimization, it efficiently connects nearby lights with subtle lines that create the illusion of depth and movement. The major intersections are defined by angular crystalline clusters that glow from within, using radial gradients to simulate internal luminosity. These elements combine to produce a sense of vast urban sprawl rendered in a single, continuous animation without any external input, relying solely on the natural motion of the lights and rotating clusters.
